group.label: Memoirs · The Shadow That Signals Victory

lines.text: Yet another day on the battlefield. Death claimed more of my comrades, and I survived one close call after another. The Raptures were as merciless as ever, and honestly... I didn't think we had any hope of winning.
But the moment that shadow appeared, all those thoughts went away.
Today, the Wings of Victory flew overhead once again, no doubt carrying the Goddesses of Victory. That thought alone made me believe we could win this seemingly impossible war.
And so, I dared to hope.
For the massive shadow to continue to show up, cover the battlefield, and lead us to victory.
